slides.title: Can a cycling helmet work for skating?
slides.sub: Usually yes. Here is what to check first.

slides.title: One standard, three activities
slides.body: EN1078 is the European helmet standard for cyclists, skateboarders and roller skaters. A CE EN1078 mark means it was tested for skating.

slides.title: Certified beats labelled
slides.body: Many cheap skating helmets carry no stated certification. An EN1078 cycling helmet from a reputable brand is the better choice.

slides.title: Beginners fall backwards
slides.body: Feet slide out and the back of the head lands first. Road cycling helmets cover that area least, so learners need more rear coverage.

slides.text: For a beginner, buy for the backward fall.

slides.title: Replace it after a crash
slides.body: Most helmets use EPS foam that crushes once and does not recover. The damage is in the liner, even when the shell looks perfect.

slides.title: Check the fit every time
slides.body: Sit it level, two finger widths above your eyebrows. It should not shift when you shake your head. Leave two fingers under the chin strap.
